name: rppl-marketing-site
description: Rppl marketing site built with Jekyll

scripts.jekyll: LIVERELOAD_PORT=${LIVERELOAD_PORT:-35731}; BUNDLE_GEMFILE=site/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll serve --source site --config site/_config.yml --port 6060 --trace --unpublished --livereload --livereload-port $LIVERELOAD_PORT
scripts.build: BUNDLE_GEMFILE=site/Gemfile bundle exec jekyll build --source site --config 'site/_config.yml' --destination _site

author: Rppl
